summary.zh: 修复 Windows 独立服务器归档的校验和 sidecar，并在发布前逐一核对所有服务器归档与 SHA-256，避免无效校验值进入正式 Release。
summary.en: Fixes the Windows standalone-server checksum sidecar and verifies every server archive against its SHA-256 before publication, preventing invalid checksum values from reaching a Release.

title.zh: Windows 服务器校验和恢复为标准 64 字符 SHA-256
title.en: Windows server checksums return to standard 64-character SHA-256

summary.zh: Windows 打包路径会让 GNU sha256sum 在输出行前添加转义标记，旧逻辑误把该标记写进 .sha256 文件，导致消费者读到的校验值不是 64 字符十六进制。现在打包器会剥离标记，并拒绝任何格式不合法的摘要。
summary.en: Windows packaging paths make GNU sha256sum prefix escaped output with a marker. The old parser copied that marker into the .sha256 file, so consumers did not receive a 64-character hexadecimal checksum. The packer now removes the marker and rejects malformed digest output.

details.zh: Release 工作流会在上传前重新计算五个平台服务器归档的 SHA-256，并同时检查 sidecar 的首个字段格式与归档字节是否匹配。
details.en: Before upload, the Release workflow now recomputes SHA-256 for all five platform server archives and verifies both the sidecar token format and its match to the archive bytes.
